name: Surena's Choker
summary: In Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder seeks the choker he gave his former apprentice, Surena Caledon. After Surena fled to join the Defias Brotherhood, Gakin sent aspiring acolytes to take it back by force.

sections.title: A Master's Lost Investment
sections.body: Gakin the Darkbinder works quietly beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, where he took Surena Caledon on as a promising student of the dark arts. Drawn to her youthful charm and magical aptitude, he gave her a valuable bloodstone choker to aid her studies. Surena abandoned her training and fled with Erlan Drudgemoor, a rogue aligned with the Defias Brotherhood. Gakin will not leave a potent artifact in a traitor’s hands. He sends initiates seeking mastery over the void to find Surena at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch and reclaim the necklace by force. Their deed will show where true loyalty lies.

faq.q: Why does Gakin the Darkbinder want Surena's Choker back?
aliases: why does gakin want the choker
faq.answer: Gakin gave the bloodstone choker to Surena when she was his apprentice. She abandoned her studies and fled with a member of the Defias Brotherhood, but Gakin will not let a traitor keep a prized artifact of dark magic.

Surena Caledon is a former apprentice warlock in Stormwind, where she showed natural talent under Gakin the Darkbinder. She turned from her tutor and fled with Erlan Drudgemoor, hiding among the Defias outlaws in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can the choker be found?
faq.answer: Surena Caledon carries the choker at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest, where she is holed up among the Defias bandits.

faq.q: What is the choker used for after it is retrieved?
aliases: what does gakin do with the choker
why do warlocks need the choker
faq.answer: Taking back the choker proves an acolyte’s ruthlessness and loyalty to Gakin the Darkbinder. He does not say what he will do with it; he laments Surena’s wasted talent and hopes his investment in the new student brings different results.

angles.text: As a Human or Gnome warlock, retrieving Surena Caledon’s choker is a foundational trial. It shows that sentimentality has no place in the pursuit of demonic power.
